title: Etaleness descends to a finite stage of a limit
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set and $(S_i,f_{ii'})$ an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] over $I$ with affine transition morphisms [pqf-def-affine-morphism], with limit $S=\varprojlim_iS_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Let $0\in I$ and let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a morphism of schemes over $S_0$, where $S_0$, $X_0$, $Y_0$ are quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For $i\ge0$ let $f_i:X_i\to Y_i$ be the base change of $f_0$ to $S_i$ ($X_i=X_0\times_{S_0}S_i$, $Y_i=Y_0\times_{S_0}S_i$, fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product]) and $f:X\to Y$ its base change to $S$. If $f$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and $f_0$ is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], then $f_i$ is etale for some $i\ge0$ (Stacks Limits, Lemma 07RP).

source.place: Lemma Tag 07RP (lemma-descend-etale, line 1949), in Situation Tag 081D (situation-descent-property, line 1739); its proof: etale is local on source and target (Morphisms, Lemma Tag 02GJ, lemma-etale-characterize, morphisms.tex line 8090; the source cites it by label, the tag 02GN given here before is lemma-composition-etale), reducing to $S_0,X_0,Y_0$ affine ('details omitted'), where it is Algebra, Lemma Tag 07RI (lemma-colimit-etale, algebra.tex line 47626)

proof.text: *Step 1 (finitely many affine triples).* Write $g_0:Y_0\to S_0$ for the structure morphism of $Y_0$ (so $g_0\circ f_0$ is that of $X_0$), $p_i:S\to S_i$ for the projections of the limit and $f_{ii'}:S_i\to S_{i'}$ ($i\ge i'$) for the transition morphisms, $f_{00}=\mathrm{id}$. Let $x\in X_0$. Choose an affine open $W\subseteq S_0$ containing $g_0(f_0(x))$, an affine open $V\subseteq g_0^{-1}(W)$ containing $f_0(x)$, and an affine open $U\subseteq f_0^{-1}(V)$ containing $x$ (every point of a scheme has an affine open neighbourhood inside any given open neighbourhood: [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-spec-points] identifies an affine open with a spectrum, whose principal opens $D(h)$ form a basis of affine opens). Since $X_0$ is quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], finitely many such triples $(W_b,V_b,U_b)$, $b=1,\dots,m$, satisfy $X_0=\bigcup_bU_b$, $f_0(U_b)\subseteq V_b$, $g_0(V_b)\subseteq W_b$. Put $A_0^b=\mathcal O_{S_0}(W_b)$, $B_0^b=\mathcal O_{Y_0}(V_b)$, $C_0^b=\mathcal O_{X_0}(U_b)$, with the ring maps $A_0^b\to B_0^b$ induced by $g_0$ and $\varphi_0^b:B_0^b\to C_0^b$ induced by $f_0$ (so $C_0^b$ is an $A_0^b$-algebra via $\varphi_0^b$ and $\varphi_0^b$ is an $A_0^b$-algebra map). By [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-into-affine-scheme], under the identifications $W_b=\operatorname{Spec}A_0^b$, $V_b=\operatorname{Spec}B_0^b$, $U_b=\operatorname{Spec}C_0^b$ of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-spec-points] the restrictions $U_b\to V_b\to W_b$ of $f_0$ and $g_0$ are $\operatorname{Spec}$ of these ring maps. Since $f_0$ is locally of finite presentation, $\varphi_0^b$ is of finite presentation by [lem-weil-pbc-lfp-affine-opens-finite-presentation]. (Only the quasi-compactness of $X_0$ is used; the quasi-separatedness assumptions of Situation 081D are not needed for this lemma.)

source.place: Lemma Tag 07RP (lemma-descend-etale, line 1949), proof: 'Being etale is local on the source and the target (Morphisms, Lemma 02GJ) hence we may assume $S_0,X_0,Y_0$ affine (details omitted)'; the finite affine covering as in the proof of Lemma Tag 01ZN (lemma-descend-affine-finite-presentation, line 1760: 'Let $Y_0=\bigcup V_{j,0}$ be a finite affine open covering'); Morphisms, Lemma Tag 01TQ (morphisms.tex line 4096) (1)$\Rightarrow$(2)

proof.text: *Step 2 (the base over $W_b$ as a colimit of rings).* Fix $b$ and drop it from the notation. For $i\ge0$ put $W_i=f_{i0}^{-1}(W)\subseteq S_i$; it is an affine open since $f_{i0}$ is affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism]; put $A_i=\mathcal O_{S_i}(W_i)$ (for $i=0$ this is $A_0$). For $i\ge i'\ge0$ the morphism $f_{ii'}$ maps $W_i$ into $W_{i'}$ and induces a ring map $A_{i'}\to A_i$; these make $(A_i)_{i\in I_{\ge0}}$ a directed system of rings over the directed set $I_{\ge0}=\{i\in I:i\ge0\}$, and by [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-into-affine-scheme] the restricted transition morphism $W_i\to W_{i'}$ is $\operatorname{Spec}(A_{i'}\to A_i)$. Let $A=\varinjlim_{i\ge0}A_i$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] with coprojections $A_i\to A$. Put $W_S=p_0^{-1}(W)\subseteq S$. By [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition] (clause on open subschemes of a stage, with $U_0=W$), $W_S$ with the restricted projections $W_S\to W_i$ is the limit of the inverse system $(W_i)_{i\ge0}$; by [lem-weil-pbc-spec-colimit-limit], $\operatorname{Spec}A$ with the morphisms $\operatorname{Spec}A\to\operatorname{Spec}A_i=W_i$ induced by the coprojections is also its limit. A limit is unique up to unique isomorphism compatible with the projections, so there is an isomorphism $W_S\cong\operatorname{Spec}A$ under which $p_0|_{W_S}:W_S\to W$ becomes $\operatorname{Spec}(A_0\to A)$; in particular $W_S$ is an affine open of $S$ and $\mathcal O_S(W_S)\cong A$ as $A_0$-algebras.

source.place: Lemma Tag 07RP (lemma-descend-etale, line 1949), proof: 'Being etale is local on the source and the target (Morphisms, Lemma 02GJ) hence we may assume $S_0,X_0,Y_0$ affine (details omitted)'; Lemma Tag 01YX (lemma-directed-inverse-system-has-limit, line 58) and Lemma Tag 01YW (line 42); written out by the agent (the reduction is 'details omitted' in the source)

proof.text: *Step 3 (the pieces of $X_T$, $Y_T$ and of $f_T$ are spectra).* Let $T$ be either $S_i$ for some $i\ge0$, with $q=f_{i0}:S_i\to S_0$, $W_T=W_i$ and $A_T=A_i$, or $S$ itself, with $q=p_0$, $W_T=W_S$ and $A_T=A$ (step 2); in both cases $W_T=q^{-1}(W)$ and $W_T=\operatorname{Spec}A_T$ over $W=\operatorname{Spec}A_0$. Let $X_T=X_0\times_{S_0}T$, $Y_T=Y_0\times_{S_0}T$ with first projections $\mathrm{pr}_1$ and second projections $\mathrm{pr}_2$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and $f_T=f_0\times\mathrm{id}_T:X_T\to Y_T$ (so $f_T=f_i$ for $T=S_i$ and $f_T=f$ for $T=S$). Put $U_T=\mathrm{pr}_1^{-1}(U)\subseteq X_T$ and $V_T=\mathrm{pr}_1^{-1}(V)\subseteq Y_T$. Since $q\circ\mathrm{pr}_2=g_0f_0\circ\mathrm{pr}_1$ maps $U_T$ into $W$, $\mathrm{pr}_2(U_T)\subseteq q^{-1}(W)=W_T$, so $U_T=\mathrm{pr}_1^{-1}(U)\cap\mathrm{pr}_2^{-1}(W_T)$, and [lem-weil-pbc-open-fibre-product] (opens $W\subseteq S_0$, $U\subseteq X_0$, $W_T\subseteq T$) identifies $U_T$ with $U\times_WW_T$, compatibly with the projections; by [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra] (and the identifications of steps 1 and 2) $U_T\cong\operatorname{Spec}(A_T\otimes_{A_0}C_0)$, with $\mathrm{pr}_1,\mathrm{pr}_2$ becoming $\operatorname{Spec}$ of $c\mapsto1\otimes c$ and $a\mapsto a\otimes1$ (tensor factors written in the order of [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-etale-ring-map]; the swap $C_0\otimes_{A_0}A_T\cong A_T\otimes_{A_0}C_0$ is the symmetry of the tensor product). In the same way $V_T\cong\operatorname{Spec}(A_T\otimes_{A_0}B_0)$. Since $\mathrm{pr}_1\circ f_T=f_0\circ\mathrm{pr}_1$ and $f_0(U)\subseteq V$, $f_T(U_T)\subseteq V_T$. The restriction $f_T|:U_T\to V_T$ and $\operatorname{Spec}(\mathrm{id}_{A_T}\otimes\varphi_0)$ are two morphisms into $V_T\cong V\times_WW_T$ with the same components: the first projection gives $f_0|_U\circ\mathrm{pr}_1$ for both (as $(\mathrm{id}\otimes\varphi_0)(1\otimes b)=1\otimes\varphi_0(b)$ and $f_0|_U=\operatorname{Spec}\varphi_0$ by step 1), the second gives $\mathrm{pr}_2$ for both (as $(\mathrm{id}\otimes\varphi_0)(a\otimes1)=a\otimes1$); by the uniqueness in the universal property of the fibre product they are equal. So $f_T|:U_T\to V_T$ is, up to these isomorphisms, $\operatorname{Spec}$ of $\mathrm{id}_{A_T}\otimes\varphi_0:A_T\otimes_{A_0}B_0\to A_T\otimes_{A_0}C_0$. Finally, for $T=S_i$ the opens $U^b_{S_i}=\mathrm{pr}_1^{-1}(U_b)$, $b=1,\dots,m$, cover $X_i$, being the preimages of the covering $X_0=\bigcup_bU_b$ of step 1.

source.place: Lemma Tag 07RP (lemma-descend-etale, line 1949), proof: 'Being etale is local on the source and the target (Morphisms, Lemma 02GJ) hence we may assume $S_0,X_0,Y_0$ affine (details omitted)'; Schemes, Lemma Tag 01JR (open-fibre-product) and Tag 01I4 (fibre product of affine schemes); written out by the agent

proof.text: *Step 4 (the hypothesis on the piece over $S$).* Put $B=A\otimes_{A_0}B_0$, $C=A\otimes_{A_0}C_0$ and $\varphi=\mathrm{id}_A\otimes\varphi_0$. Let $j_U:U_S\to X$ and $j_V:V_S\to Y$ be the inclusions (step 3 with $T=S$). They are open immersions, hence etale by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation](1); $f\circ j_U$ is etale by part (2), since $f$ is etale by hypothesis; and $f\circ j_U=j_V\circ(f|:U_S\to V_S)$, so $f|$ is etale by part (3) (with $g=j_V$). Isomorphisms are open immersions, hence etale, and composites of etale morphisms are etale (parts (1), (2)); so by step 3 the morphism $\operatorname{Spec}C\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ induced by $\varphi$ is etale. By step 1, $\varphi_0:B_0\to C_0$ is a homomorphism of $A_0$-algebras of finite presentation.

source.place: Lemma Tag 07RP (line 1949), hypotheses (1) and (2), carried to an affine piece; Morphisms, Lemma Tag 02GJ 'Moreover' clause (restriction of an etale morphism to opens is etale; morphisms.tex line 8107)

proof.text: *Step 5 (the algebra fact, and larger indices).* By step 4 the data $(A_i)_{i\ge0}$, $A$, $\varphi_0:B_0\to C_0$ satisfy the hypotheses of [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-etale-ring-map] (over the directed set $I_{\ge0}$, which contains $0$); so there is $i_b\ge0$ such that $\operatorname{Spec}C_{i_b}\to\operatorname{Spec}B_{i_b}$, induced by $\varphi_{i_b}=\mathrm{id}\otimes\varphi_0$, is etale, where $B_i=A_i\otimes_{A_0}B_0$, $C_i=A_i\otimes_{A_0}C_0$. This persists for every $i\ge i_b$. Indeed, write $k=i_b$, regard $B_i$ as a $B_k$-algebra via the transition map $A_k\to A_i$ tensored with $B_0$, and $C_k$ via $\varphi_k$. By [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-cancel-base-change] (with $R=A_0$, $S=B_0$, $B=A_k$, and the $B_0$-algebra $C_0$) $C_k\cong B_k\otimes_{B_0}C_0$ as $B_k$-algebras, and the same at $i$; by [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-cancel-base-change] again (with $R=B_0$, $S=B_k$, $B=C_0$ and the $B_k$-algebra $B_i$) $B_i\otimes_{B_k}(B_k\otimes_{B_0}C_0)\cong B_i\otimes_{B_0}C_0$. Composing, $B_i\otimes_{B_k}C_k\cong C_i$ as $B_i$-algebras, by $\beta\otimes(a\otimes c)\mapsto\varphi_i(\beta)\cdot(\bar a\otimes c)$ with $\bar a$ the image of $a\in A_k$ in $A_i$ (checked on the generators $\beta\otimes(a\otimes c)$). By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-ring-base-change] (with $R=B_k$, $A=C_k$, $S=B_i$) the morphism $\operatorname{Spec}(B_i\otimes_{B_k}C_k)\to\operatorname{Spec}B_i$ is etale; composing with the isomorphism $\operatorname{Spec}C_i\cong\operatorname{Spec}(B_i\otimes_{B_k}C_k)$, which is compatible with the maps from $B_i$ (since $\beta\otimes1\mapsto\varphi_i(\beta)$), [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation](1),(2) give that $\operatorname{Spec}C_i\to\operatorname{Spec}B_i$, induced by $\varphi_i$, is etale.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 07RI (lemma-colimit-etale, line 47626), cited in the proof of Lemma 07RP ('The corresponding algebra fact'); the persistence to larger indices is written out by the agent (base change, Algebra Lemma Tag 00U2 (2))

proof.text: *Step 6 (a common index; $f_i$ is etale).* The set $I$ is directed and there are finitely many $b$, so there is $i\in I$ with $i\ge0$ and $i\ge i_b$ for $b=1,\dots,m$. For each $b$, step 5 gives that $\operatorname{Spec}C^b_i\to\operatorname{Spec}B^b_i$, induced by $\mathrm{id}_{A^b_i}\otimes\varphi^b_0$, is etale; by step 3 (with $T=S_i$) and [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation](1),(2) (isomorphisms are etale, composites of etale morphisms are etale), the restriction $f_i|:U^b_{S_i}\to V^b_{S_i}$ is etale, and hence so is $f_i\circ j_b=j'_b\circ f_i|$, where $j_b:U^b_{S_i}\to X_i$ and $j'_b:V^b_{S_i}\to Y_i$ are the inclusions (open immersions, etale by part (1)). The opens $U^b_{S_i}$ cover $X_i$ (step 3), so $f_i$ is etale by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-local-on-source].

lean.statement: theorem Etale.exists_stage_of_inverseLimit {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)] (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i₀ : I) [CompactSpace (D.obj (op i₀))] [QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj (op i₀))] (X₀ Y₀ : Over (D.obj (op i₀))) [CompactSpace X₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X₀.left] [CompactSpace Y₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y₀.left] (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f₀.left] (hf : Etale (((Over.pullback (c.π.app (op i₀))).map f₀).left)) : ∃ (i : I) (h : i₀ ≤ i), Etale (((Over.pullback (D.map (homOfLE h).op)).map f₀).left)

reviewed_lean.note: I : Type u (same universe as Scheme.{u}, #check confirms) Preorder+IsDirected, i0 gives nonemptiness; D : Iop => Scheme with IsAffineHom transitions; Cone+IsLimit; S0,X0,Y0 qcqs via CompactSpace/QuasiSeparatedSpace; X0,Y0 : Over S0, f0 over S0 with LocallyOfFinitePresentation f0.left; X_i,Y_i,f_i and f via Over.pullback (= pullback g.hom f, Over.pullback_obj_left); hf Etale at limit; conclusion exists i >= i0 with Etale f_i; no hollow hyps, no duplicate (grep 07RP/descend-etale), only file+item record in diff
